_comment: Config for the epi linelist aggregation/nowcasting/plotting/mapping pipeline in this repo. Adapted from BDBV2026-Linelist_Processing's pipelines/pipeline_configs.json: this repo has no raw_subdir (no raw exports land here) and reads dhis2_processed_linelist_ctsafe.csv (the de-identified snapshot auto-synced from BDBV2026-Linelist_Processing) instead of the full dhis2_processed_linelist.csv. Update epi_linelist.nowcasting.analysis_start when the analytic window changes, to match the upstream repo's config.

province._min_confirmed_cases_note: Provinces with total confirmed cases strictly greater than this value are included in province-level nowcasting and growth-rate outputs.

delay_distribution_fit._comment: Config for the onset-to-reporting delay distribution fit in 1-fit_delay_distributions.R (epidist/cmdstanr). onset_cutoff_start excludes a known onset-date data-quality issue prior to that date -- confirm/update periodically as data quality upstream changes.

date_imputation._comment: Config for imputing missing/out-of-range onset dates in 2-date_imputation.R, by sampling from the best-fit onset_to_reporting_days distribution (delay_distribution_fit_summary.csv, written by 1-fit_delay_distributions.R). interval_width sets the [lower, upper] onset-date interval recorded per imputed row (0.95 = the fitted delay's 2.5th/97.5th percentile). max_resample_attempts bounds how many times an out-of-[min_days, max_days] draw is redrawn before it's clamped instead. random_seed is fixed so reruns against unchanged data reproduce the same imputed dates rather than reshuffling them every run.
